description: Defines the class 'pdu_session_resource_modification_routine' which handles modification of PDU session resources, including methods for request handling, response generation, and context filling, within a 5G network protocol implementation.

classes.name: pdu_session_resource_modification_routine
classes.description: Handles the modification of an existing PDU session resources, including request processing and response generation.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the routine with a given coroutine context, processing the modification request.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the routine as a string.

methods.name: fill_e1ap_bearer_context_modification_request
methods.description: Fills the E1AP bearer context modification request message.

methods.name: fill_initial_e1ap_bearer_context_modification_request
methods.description: Fills the initial E1AP bearer context modification request message.

methods.name: valid_5qi
methods.description: Validates the 5QI (QoS Flow Identifier) in a flow setup request.

methods.name: generate_pdu_session_resource_modify_response
methods.description: Generates a response message for the PDU session resource modification, indicating success or failure.
